attributes.name: Spirit Sword
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Acrobatics skill + 1d6+1. If proficient with weapons, you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d8. If you have the Monk or Samurai trait, you may recharge this card instead. If the bane has the Undead trait, add another 1d8.

When you encounter a non-henchman, non-villain monster that has the Undead trait, recharge this card to defeat the monster.
